relations.rationale: Mina being a year older than Fay is consistent with and supports the idea that Fay could be the youngest at the table.
Fay being the youngest has no bearing on players comparing standings on a chalkboard.
Mina and Jude being in different houses is consistent with there being multiple houses, but doesn't establish the specific number three.

Comparing standings near the end of the session and helping stack chairs as the meeting wound down both describe sequential end-of-session activities, but one doesn't cause or imply the other beyond temporal proximity.
